bugs.title: Game canvas is off-centre in any non-3:2 window, and the letterbox bars are a different colour from the game
bugs.where: Every screen, window sizes other than 3:2 (e.g. 1280x720, 1920x1080, 800x1000)
steps: Open the game in a 1280x720 window (or 800x1000 portrait)
Look at the bars either side of (or above/below) the game
bugs.expected: The game is centred with equal bars on both sides, in the game's own background colour.
bugs.actual: The canvas is pushed right/down by half the bar width: 1280x720 gives 150 px left and 50 px right; 1920x1080 gives 225 px left and 75 px right; 800x1000 gives 350 px above and 117 px below. Likely double centring: Phaser's autoCenter CENTER_BOTH adds margins while index.html's #game is also a flex centre. The bars are purple #2b2233 (index.html) instead of the game's brown #2e2624. Nothing is cut off.
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2 runs, every non-3:2 size)

setup.settings: High contrast On, Animations Off, Music Off, Sound effects Off

bugs.title: With page zoom at 200% the game spills off the top-left of the window and can't be scrolled back; START and the level cards can't be clicked
bugs.where: Title and map (any screen), body zoom 2
steps: Open the game in a 480x800 (or 960x640) window
Run document.body.style.zoom = '2' (emulated browser zoom, as the agent brief asks)
Try to click START, then (after Enter) the LEVEL 1 card
bugs.expected: The game refits to the window, or at least the page scrolls so every part can be reached.
bugs.actual: The canvas does not refit: at 480x800 its rect is left -240, top 320, 960x640, so the left half is off-screen at a negative offset that scrolling can't reach (scrollTo stays 0,0), and START and the LEVEL 1 card fall below the fold. At 960x640 the rect is -480,-320, 1920x1280. Mouse clicks on START and the level card do nothing; the keyboard (Enter) still works. Caveat: real Ctrl+ zoom shrinks the CSS viewport, so Phaser FIT just refits there; the game then never gets bigger with browser zoom, which is no help to a low-vision player (the only enlargement is Options > Text size).

not_bugs: No page or console errors on any screen, size or zoom.
Animations Off: zero running tweens on every screen checked; Credits stays still; Ending part 1 still paces the chat lines (pace, not animation); typing dots stay still.
Sound Off: every sound effect has a visual twin (stars, OH NO / CLEARED / PERFECT text, new page/friend cards).
Stars are never colour-only: empty stars are outlined and 'N of 3 stars' is written next to them; starred lines get a filled star plus a border; locked districts say LOCKED.
Options buttons show the chosen value by fill, not hue alone.
layoutProblems chat 'off screen' hits are scrolled-off lines inside the masked chat panel; Credits hits are its scroll list; Friends '14 / LEVELS TOGETHER' overlap is the stamp by design.
Results '↓ scroll for more' sitting over a half-cut review line is the scroll edge, not overflow.
Title tagline and Credits footer sit over busy art but have a drop shadow and stay legible.
640x427 and 1920x1080 scale cleanly with nothing cut off (only AX-01's off-centre offset); text at 640x427 is very small (footer hints about 8 px) as expected from FIT scaling.
High contrast set from Options with the keyboard is saved and survives a reload.
Esc on Ending part 1 goes to part 2, Esc again goes to the map.
Reread the chat was blocked once by the new-friend card on a dev-shortcut Outcome; that card is modal by design.
feedback: High contrast helps the panels a lot, but the small pixel-font labels (badges, names, footer hints) stay small and tinted, and nothing in the game gets bigger with browser zoom; a larger heading size under Text size: Large would help most.
